input: Price out a bathroom tile replacement project

gold.taskTitle: Price Out a Bathroom Tile Replacement Project
gold.taskDescription: Gather all the necessary details to accurately estimate the cost of replacing tiles in a bathroom.

questions.title: Which surfaces are getting tiled: floor, walls, or both?
questions.description: Identify exactly which surfaces in the bathroom need tile replacement.

questions.title: What are the square footage measurements of those surfaces?
questions.description: Determine the total area to be tiled so material quantities can be calculated.

questions.title: What type of tile are you considering: ceramic, porcelain, natural stone?
questions.description: Identify the tile material, as this is one of the biggest drivers of cost.

questions.title: Are you hiring a contractor or doing this yourself?
questions.description: Clarify whether labor costs need to be included in the estimate.

questions.title: Does the existing tile need demolition and removal first?
questions.description: Determine if demo work is part of the scope, which adds labor and disposal costs.

questions.title: Is the subfloor or wall backer currently in good condition?
questions.description: Assess whether substrate repair or replacement needs to be factored into the budget.

questions.title: What is your target budget range for this project?
questions.description: Establish a budget ceiling to guide decisions on tile selection and labor.
